title: Bandgap-engineered In2S3 quantum dots anchored on oxygen-doped g-C3N4: forging a dynamic n–n heterojunction for enhanced persulfate activation and degradation of metronidazole
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00859F, Paper
Soumya Ranjan Mishra, Vishal Gadore, Saptarshi Roy, Md. Ahmaruzzaman
A novel n–n heterojunction catalyst was fabricated by anchoring In2S3 QDs onto oxygen-doped g-C3N4, achieving 98.17 ± 1.53% efficiency in degrading metronidazole via persulfate activation under visible light irradiation within 25 min.
